articles.title: Miden bets on privacy stablecoins with introduction of USDCx
articles.snippet: USDCx will let users transact without publicly exposing balances, counterparties or transaction histories, while allowing selective disclosure for compliance.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: When capital can't move fast enough, markets pay the price
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, LMAX Group's Jenna Wright argues that markets break down not from too little capital but from capital stuck in the wrong place, trapped by settlement cycles while risk reprices by the minute. She makes the case that stablecoins and tokenization are quietly becoming the plumbing that lets money move as fast as the risk it supports.

articles.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin
articles.snippet: HashKey Exchange and OSL Group are now authorized distributors, enabling institutional and professional investors to mint and redeem HKDAP tokens.

articles.title: Bank of England to test stablecoin, digital currency use in cross-border finance
articles.snippet: The BOE-led Digital Pound Lab will test trade-finance interoperability, in which exporters receive stablecoins while importers settle in a potential digital pound.

articles.title: Bank of England tests stablecoin, digital pound interoperability in cross-border payments
articles.snippet: The Digital Pound Lab is testing a cross-border trade finance flow combining stablecoin payments with simulated digital pound settlement.
